summary: {person} asks an independent auditor to check whether a year-round service promise reaches park visitors.
realLife: Seattle’s Park District requested a review of restroom upkeep and availability through Resolution 51, leading to the city auditor’s fieldwork.
gates: A governing board resolution, a stated service promise and an independent audit assignment.
weights: A year-round promise invites checks outside the busiest season.
inGame: needs: governing resolution, audit scope, service goal and dates of field visits.

turns.what: The board asks the department for a dated response.
turns.pulledBy: The audit documents a service gap.

turns.what: The auditor identifies what still needs checking.
turns.pulledBy: The inspection cannot test winter conditions yet.
